faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Larkspur?
faq.answer: Larkspur homeowners typically invest $7,500 to $17,000 for a full window replacement project. This affluent Marin County community features a mix of Victorian-era homes in the historic downtown, craftsmans, and contemporary hillside properties with Bay and Mt. Tamalpais views. Single window installation starts at approximately $620.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Larkspur?
faq.answer: Yes. Larkspur requires a building permit for window replacements. Properties in the historic downtown corridor may be subject to design review. Our team manages all permit applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Larkspur?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Larkspur commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Larkspur?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Larkspur replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Larkspur?
faq.answer: Most Larkspur projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
